blocks.text: ISRAEL AND PROPHECY— “‘In 1988 Israel will have been a reborn nation for 40 years! We have already written significant events to be associated with Israel and the Middle East! We have seen much already come to pass!’’ — ‘‘At this writing they have an uprising of Arab youth in their streets, and it’s the worst riots they have had in 10 years! . . . But the real enemy is slowly rising and who will act as their friend at first! At this 40 year period we should watch for the rising of the anti-christ! Surely he is working undemeath and in a few years it should appear more openly; and will make a covenant with the state of Israel for 7 years to guarantee their peace!’’ (Dan. 9:27, Dan. 11:30) — ‘‘And then in the middle of these 7 years he will turn upon the real people of Israel and desecrate the Temple that has been restored! . .. In which apocalyptic events will follow throughout the earth! Also occuring with Israel’s 40 years as a nation are signs in the heavens!”’ — Gen. 1:14 says, ‘‘And let them be for signs!’’ — ‘‘Jesus said when speaking about all of these things and including Israel (fig tree) that there would be signs in the stars, the sun and moon, etc. (Luke 21:25) — In 1988 the planet Mars, scientists say, will continue its closest approach to the earth called, The Perihelion! . . . It has not been this near since they can remember! It’s closest point will be in September 1988! Also remember that this is near the time that the United States will elect its next president! . . . And as you know the Lord told me years ago that in a certain cycle we would have a president totally different than we have ever had at any time in history! Already I have written, and later on will write more about this!’’ — ‘‘Also concerning this approach of Mars prophetically the ancients have claimed it has always been associated to turmoil, unusual changes, wars and severe troubles continuing years afterwards! Finally exploding into various crisis, no doubt as the Scrolls predicted, riots, rebellion, famine, crime and etc.!”’

THE FAMINE SIGN— In the 70’s the Scripts revealed severe famine would start, and that it would grow in different stages affecting various nations until at some point in the 90’s several billion will have vanished from the earth! Finally a world food shortage will occur; the mark given!’ — ‘‘Even right now with the exploding population we are suddenly brought face to face with the approaching of world hunger such as history has never seen! It will be of such magnitude that no remedy of man will be able to avert it!’’ (Rev. 6:8) — ‘‘Right now in the time we are living in is in the stage of this Scripture! Amos 4:7, ‘And also I have withholden the rain pe you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city; one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered!’ ’’ — ‘‘We have been seeing such a situation in our time! Some countries have been spared like the United States and etc., but others have not! We know later like Russia, China and other nations that surround the Middle East will begin to go into severe famine, drought and food shortage!’’ — “As we said, right now it is raining in one place (often floods, too) and not raining in another place and later it will affect the entire earth! No rain for 3% years! (Rev. 11:3,6) — This includes our nation!’’ PROPHETIC SCRIPTURES — ‘‘The Bible gives a definite warning to the people who live in the latter days!’’ — Isa. 5:8-9, ‘‘Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth! In mine ears said the Lord of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant!’’ — “‘We are seeing prophecy fulfilling right before our eyes! In our big cities we see house to house literally upon no end, and in the country we see field to field where there seems to be no let up! At that time there would hardly be any place left to dwell alone; such a population! Concerning this conjestion the Lord said woe, the houses shall be desolate, even the great and fair, without inhabitants!’’ — ‘‘In other words when an earthquake would strike, because there were so many in one place it would destroy many homes and cities! The same concerning tornados or floods! . . . But most of all concerning weapons of war, especially atomic radiation! Because of them being placed so near together it would wipe out the inhabitants in great numbers! Like for instance if and when a hydrogen bomb strikes New York, tens of millions of people would be vaporized! It would suddenly be a desolate metropolis!’’ — ‘‘So we see that because of the crowded conditions in our time the Lord gave a special warning to be ready and alert!’’

END TIME PROPHECY— ‘“‘Isa. 17:12-14. . . surely as one reads this they can sense the age that surrounds us now, and the ominous conclusion of nations!’’ — ‘‘Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters! The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind!’’ — “Tf you read this closely you can see a modern world rushing in every direction! Many people and like the noise of rushing water! This describes the air traffic, trains, cars, trucks and factories all humming along making a noise like rushing waters, and surely this is the sound of our large cities!’’ — ‘‘Vrs. 13 and 14 reveal to us that, that is the prophetic destiny of the nations in the later time!’’ SCIENCE — INVENTIONS AND PROPHECY — ‘Because lately of the breakthrough in many new inventions including the super conductor activity, science claims that it will bring us to the threshold of a new age!’’ — ‘‘The Lord wants to reveal this because science and inventions will swiftly bring this age to a conclusion!’’ (Rev. 13:15) — ‘‘We see Vr. 13 reveals in science the inventions of atomic fire, laser, energy weapons and, of course, electricity! This also reveals that the anti-christ will use television in his thrust towards world dominion! And in his final days we see he is still using satellite television for his own purpose!’’ (Rev. 11:9-11) — ‘‘The Bible also reveals radio, T.V. and also hidden devises in evesdropping which has caused many a problem for our congressmen and presidents!’’ — Eccl. 10:20 reveals this: “‘Curse not the king, nor not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of ‘the air’ shall carry the voice, and that which ‘hath wings’ shall tell the matter!’’ — ‘‘Eccl. 7:29 reveals man will seek out many inventions! . . . Job 38:35 revealed not only radio and television, but all communications through electricity! And he revealed that the voices traveled over it! . . . Isa. 60:8 reveals modem aircraft and space flight, “Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as a dove to their windows’ (space stations and etc.)! — Man will still yet go farther into space and will eventually have a space war!’’ CONTINUING PROPHECY — ‘‘Science is trying to assume God-like powers in many ways! They are creating fantastic computers and lifelike robots! They are working on artificial life! Experts are working hard to perfect life-like beings (robots) with silicon chip brains, that can think, make choices independently and take actions without the assistance of humans! Companies are already working on these projects including the Japanese!’’ — ‘‘A well-known writer says that soon we shall have robots as companions and even as sex partners! This will be made possible by new achievements in robotic technology looming on the horizon, achievements which include the use of materials similar to human flesh and the manufacture of organic brains or biological computer units! He says this is not science-fiction talk but it’s a reality!”’ — “‘Actually in a less complicated way in this country and in Japan they already have these type of companions for peer! Finally men become so smart they manipulate the forces of this planet and bring down their own destruction in the god of forces!’’ (Dan. 11 336-39)

CONTINUING— ‘‘We see man maketh fire to come down out of the atom! And in the not too distant future it will turn and pursue him!”’ — Isa. 29:6, ‘‘Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the ‘flame of devouring’ fire!’’ — ‘‘Joel 2:3 reveals in our modern time that it would look like a Garden of Eden, but after the ‘devouring flame’ it was to look upon like a desolate wilderness! You might say that man’s inventions backfired upon him!’’

THE PROPHETIC VALUES— 1988 — ‘‘I just finished a message here and will write this in part! . . . We are entering the year 88, a very important number and it is intensified! As 7 marks completion, so 8 is a new beginning!’’ — ‘‘Christ arose on the first day of the week, also called the 8th day! Eight souls were saved in the Ark! The transfiguration of Christ took place on the 8th day!’’ (Luke 9:28) — “Eight starts a new series! . . . Elijah worked 8 major miracles and was translated! . . . Eight means new creative things appearing! As we see, it is associated to the miraculous; for good or for bad!’’ (Rev. 13:11-15) — “‘It is also associated to spiritual things in the same manner! Our next president will be elected under the number 88 (2 eights, intensified)! New era emerging! So 88 — octave 8. . . this is an opinion, but wouldn’t it be wonderful if between right now and the next 8 years the Lord cometh!’’ — ‘‘But know ye this . . . I predict the new age will be in the miraculous both ways (science and spiritual) etc.! Startling and unusual, plus the world working towards fantasy and illusion!’ . . . Watch and pray!
